verdicts.note: Extract: 'New-user retention to 90 days is still about 10% according to Linden Lab, having apparently remained more or less unchanged over the last 12 months.' Neville Hobson post dated 29 Jan 2007 quotes same 10%-at-90-days figure (via Tateru Nino). Secondhand reports of Linden numbers; original Linden stat page not in results.

Secondary copy of Rose's Wired piece reproduces: >85% of avatars abandoned; ~7M avatars publicised, ~4M distinct individuals, ~1M logged in in previous 30 days; Sears traffic 281, Coke Virtual Thirst 27. Original wired.com page not fetched.

Confirmed: ~400M user hours in 2008 (+61%), 112M in Q4, Q4 2008 peak concurrency 76,000 (+6.7% vs Q3). Corrections: US$361M U2U is a PC World figure not found in Linden's own release, and the +54% was a Q4-vs-Q4 comparison (Linden's own annual figure is LindeX exchange volume US$108M, +33%). All-time peak: Wikipedia gives 88,200 in Q1 2009 (claim says 88,000 in 2009, close). The Q3 2009 '>77,000 after bot policy' detail was not found in any extract; Linden's Q2 2009 report did discuss bot-policy effects on hours/logins. Treat $361M and the Q3 2009 figure as unconfirmed.

Early June 2010 restructuring with 30% staff cut; Kingdon stepped down Thursday 24 June 2010; Rosedale (chairman) interim CEO, CFO Bob Komin added COO. The '300+ staff' headcount and 'merged product and engineering' were not in the extracts. Rod Humble was named CEO in Dec 2010.

Hypergrid Business (Sept 2013) confirms Renderosity statement 'Renderosity products can not be used in Second Life for any reason' and names CG Textures among sites forbidding upload. Linden's community blog 'Updates to Section 2.3 of the Terms of Service' and modemworld confirm the revision on Wed 16 July 2014 with the phrase 'Inworld or otherwise on the Service as permitted by you through your interactions with the Service'. The 'affirmative user action' wording was not quoted verbatim in extracts but is consistent with 'as permitted by you through your interactions'.

SL wiki: initial map 157 regions, expanded 3-10 July 2009; ~850 move tickets 29 Jun-24 Jul 2009; Viewer 1.23 'Adult enabled' and Zindra opened 15 June 2009 (Engadget coverage 16 June). Nuance: 15 Sep 2009 is the date after which publicly promoted adult content had to be on Zindra or private Adult regions (i.e. a content-relocation deadline, not a move-ticket deadline); remaining Zindra land auctioned from 8 Sep 2009. The 12 March 2009 announcement date was not in the extracts (prior knowledge).

Reuters bureau announced early/mid October 2006 with Adam Pasick as 'Adam Reuters' (confirmed). Second House of Sweden opened 30 May 2007 by Carl Bildt, second after the Maldives (confirmed). Corrections: November 2008 is when the closure became public (The Baron 21 Nov, Press Gazette 25 Nov); accounts say the bureau was quietly shuttered in September (CSMonitor) or October 2008 (MediaShift). The 400,000 SEK cost rests on a single blog (kullin.net); no official Swedish Institute figure found.

THE Journal (3 Nov 2010): policy 'would essentially double the normal region rates' effective 1 Jan 2011, with pre-paid 6-24 month contracts as a softer path. Hypergrid Business (Aug 2013) and modemworld confirm the 50% discount returned, announced Wed 24 July 2013, for accredited institutions and 501(c)(3)s, though on terms not identical to the old programme. The 'drove institutions to OpenSim' effect was not directly in extracts.

SL wiki: origins 21 Sept 2004 as the Neualtenburg Project, renamed Neufreistadt 2005, then CDS by referendum; six-region microcontinent (A230); ~80 citizens; 20th anniversary 21 Sept 2024. Land store confirms six regions and land ownership = citizenship. The three-person Executive / five-member RA / five-member SC structure comes from the Steamlands fan wiki, which is dated (it lists three sims), so current council sizes are unconfirmed.

Search returned nothing containing 49,798, 26,663 or ~9,033; Daniel Voyager's 2025 posts did not surface in results and page fetching is blocked. Closest datapoints: 27,334 regions in mid-Feb 2022 and >70M registered accounts (webtribunal, citing Voyager). Figures remain third-party tracker claims as in the ledger.

additional_findings: Wikipedia gives the all-time peak concurrency as 88,200 in Q1 2009 (not Q3); Linden's own 2008 release reports LindeX exchange volume of US$108M (+33%), and the +54% U2U growth was Q4-over-Q4.
BetaNews (2007) derived ~320,000 everyday users from Linden's ~10% retention over ~3.2M distinct accounts; comScore separately estimated 1.28M 'active users'.
Wired 2007: top traffic locations on a June day were Money Island (136,000) and Sexy Beach (133,000).
Reuters' bureau closure was quiet: CSMonitor says September 2008, MediaShift says October 2008; November 2008 is only the date it was noticed.
The CDS wiki page reports a constant community of roughly 80 citizens and a 20th-anniversary celebration on 21 Sept 2024.

The restored 2013 education discount (announced 24 July 2013) covered private-region set-up and maintenance for accredited institutions and 501(c)(3)s; Hypergrid Business reported educators were wary of taking it up.
The July 2014 ToS change was presented to the SL Bar Association by attorney Agenda Faromet on 2 Aug 2014, alongside the new Skill Gaming policy.
Rod Humble was named Linden Lab CEO in December 2010, ending Rosedale's interim tenure.
Method note: WebFetch/curl blocked; all verdicts rest on search-result extracts, not full pages. 12 of 12 searches used.
